skill.name: word-stats
skill.description: Analyze text for word count, character count, reading time, speaking time, and basic sentence statistics.
skill.summary: Provides fast word, character, time, and sentence statistics for supplied text.
skill.author: humanizerai

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by a Markdown code fence in the documented output format. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The detected backticks at SKILL.md line 20 open a Markdown output-format code fence. They do not invoke Ruby, shell execution, or any external command.

content.value_statement: Writers and editors often need quick text metrics before publishing or revising. This skill returns word, character, time, and sentence statistics in a compact table.
actual_capabilities: Counts words, characters with spaces, and characters without spaces.
Counts sentences and paragraphs in supplied text.
Estimates reading time using 238 words per minute.
Estimates speaking time using 150 words per minute.
Reports unique words, average word length, and longest word.
Reports average, longest, and shortest sentence length.
limitations: Statistics depend on the text provided in the prompt.
It does not edit, rewrite, or improve the text unless asked separately.
Reading and speaking times are estimates based on fixed average speeds.
Unusual punctuation or formatting can affect sentence and paragraph counts.

use_cases.title: Check Draft Length
use_cases.description: Measure a blog post, article, or essay before submission or publication.

use_cases.title: Estimate Presentation Time
use_cases.description: Calculate speaking time for a script, lesson, or recorded message.

use_cases.title: Audit Copy Requirements
use_cases.description: Confirm that marketing copy fits word and character limits.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Word Count
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for simple length metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use word-stats on this text and return the standard statistics: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Reading Time Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Estimate how long readers need for a draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this draft with word-stats and focus on reading time, word count, and sentence length: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Speech Timing Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use word-stats for this script and highlight speaking time, sentence count, and longest sentence: [paste script]

prompt_templates.title: Publication Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for multiple publishing constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this text with word-stats, then flag whether it fits a 700 word limit and a 3 minute speaking target: [paste text]

output_examples.input: A short paragraph for a quick length check.
output_examples.output: The result includes word count, character count, sentence count, estimated reading time, and estimated speaking time.

output_examples.input: A presentation script for a timed recording.
output_examples.output: The result shows total words, speaking time, sentence metrics, and the longest sentence length.

output_examples.input: Marketing copy that must fit a platform limit.
output_examples.output: The result reports characters with spaces, characters without spaces, words, paragraphs, and average word length.

best_practices: Paste the final text exactly as it should be measured.
Include headings and captions when they count toward the limit.
State any word, character, or time target in the prompt.
anti_patterns: Do not expect exact speaking time for every speaker or language.
Do not use it as a grammar or style editor without a separate request.
Do not paste private text unless your workspace policy allows it.

faq.question: What text statistics does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides counts, time estimates, word variety metrics, and sentence length metrics.

faq.question: Does it change my text?
faq.answer: No. It reports statistics only unless you ask for a separate editing task.

faq.question: How is reading time calculated?
faq.answer: It divides the word count by 238 words per minute.

faq.question: How is speaking time calculated?
faq.answer: It divides the word count by 150 words per minute.

faq.question: Can it check character limits?
faq.answer: Yes. It reports characters with spaces and characters without spaces.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
